_comment: FIRST EXAMPLE RECIPE — SKELETON (user content, kept out of the engine, ADR-006). Reflects the CORRECTED flow (Session 2): an order POPUP shows a Close button; you click Close; the order then maps to the HOME screen as a clean Accept button. (The old 'Slide to Accept' draft was wrong — no drag in the current flow.) The targets below are PLACEHOLDERS: fill them from a capture (see docs/CAPTURE_GUIDE.md + scripts/capture_helper.py). Two modes — see _mode below.
_mode: DEFAULT = CLOSE-ONLY (safe): auto-Close each popup and leave the home-screen Accept for you to tap (keeps your phone verify step). To make it AUTO-ACCEPT (hands-off, removes your manual verify), append the step in _accept_step_to_enable after the last step. This is a real fork — decide it deliberately.

_accept_step_to_enable._note: Paste this as a new last step ONLY if you want auto-Accept. Replace target with the real Accept from capture.

_open_questions_for_the_author: After Accept is clicked/tapped, what happens? Does the order vanish and the home Accept disappear until the next order? (The engine already skips a step whose target isn't found, so a blind loop is safe, but knowing this lets us tune it.)
Between clicking Close and the home Accept appearing, is there a load/animation delay? (We use wait_for, not a fixed sleep, so it self-adjusts — just confirm it appears reliably.)
Does a Close ever appear WITHOUT an order (other modals)? If so we make the Close target more specific from the capture (selector/frame), not just text='Close'.
name: P2P.me — close order popups (Accept left to you)
